name: spooler-ui
description: Spooler pages (Vue 3 + PrimeVue 5, shared Orca UI foundation 5.0.8), built into one offline HTML file shipped as plugin/spooler/app.html

scripts.build: node node_modules/@orca-plugins/ui-foundation/scripts/vue-tsc.mjs --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/emit.mjs && python3 ../scripts/embed_ui.py
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:page
